name: BackupVault Cloud Backup
description_en:
BackupVault is a UK backup service provider that selects among multiple underlying vendors rather than exposing one universal backup engine. Its current site lists Acronis, AvePoint, N-able and Redstor, with SaaS and server/desktop protection offered according to workload.

A buyer therefore needs a service specification: which system is protected, which vendor and storage location are used, who can restore, and what retention and recovery obligations apply. This profile uses Microsoft 365 as a concrete documented workflow while keeping the wider provider boundary explicit.
description_zh:
BackupVault 是英国备份服务商，会按需求选择不同底层厂商，而非提供一个通用备份引擎。当前官网列出 Acronis、AvePoint、N-able、Redstor，并按工作负载提供 SaaS 和服务器／桌面保护。

采购需明确服务规格：保护什么系统、使用哪个厂商和存储位置、谁能恢复，以及保留和恢复责任。本文用有文档的 Microsoft 365 流程说明具体使用方式，同时保留服务商与单品的边界。

sections.title_en: Select a service around the workload
sections.en:
The homepage presents Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Dynamics, Entra ID and Salesforce backup alongside security and migration services. These adjacent services are not automatically included in a backup contract. The provider says it matches the underlying vendor to recovery objectives, features and budget.

For a business protecting mailboxes and a local file server, ask for separate coverage and recovery descriptions. A single supplier relationship does not establish identical retention, restore methods or storage architecture across those workloads.
sections.zh:
首页列出 Microsoft 365、Google Workspace、Dynamics、Entra ID 和 Salesforce 备份，同时另有安全及迁移服务。这些相邻服务不会自动包含在备份合同中。服务商说明会按恢复目标、功能和预算匹配底层厂商。

例如，同时保护邮箱与本地文件服务器的企业，应分别索取覆盖和恢复说明。供应商相同，不代表不同工作负载的保留期、恢复方式和存储架构相同。

sections.title_en: From tenant connection to a recovered item
sections.title_zh: 从租户连接到恢复单个项目
sections.en:
The Microsoft 365 page describes a web-managed connection without installing local backup hardware or software. Its scope includes Exchange Online, OneDrive, SharePoint and Teams, with item-level, out-of-place, point-in-time and offline export options described. Permissions and the chosen underlying solution still need to be established during onboarding.

A useful pilot is to protect a test mailbox and document library, delete a disposable message and edit a sample document, then restore the required historical items without overwriting live content. Check restored permissions and content separately. This is a proposed exercise, not a hands-on result or a claim that every listed object has identical restore behavior.
sections.zh:
Microsoft 365 页面说明通过网页管理连接，无需安装本地备份硬件或软件，范围包括 Exchange Online、OneDrive、SharePoint 和 Teams，并说明单项、异地、时间点恢复和离线导出。接入时仍需确认权限及所选底层方案。

试点可保护测试邮箱与文档库，删除可丢弃邮件、修改样例文档，再恢复所需历史项目，避免覆盖线上内容。恢复后的权限和正文应分别核对。这是建议演练，不是实测结果，也不表示所有对象都具备相同恢复行为。

sections.title_en: Resolve page conflicts before setting a recovery objective
sections.title_zh: 设定恢复目标前解决页面冲突
sections.en:
The same Microsoft 365 page mentions connecting up to six times daily and elsewhere lists up to four backups daily. It also offers a 30-day trial while the data-centre page advertises a 14-day trial. These are unresolved differences in current public material, not a basis for silently choosing the more attractive number.

Ask the provider to specify the selected service’s schedule, retention, object coverage and trial period. Backup frequency is not itself a guarantee that every source change was captured; inspect actual job and restore results. No generic “Microsoft never backs up data” claim is adopted from the sales copy.
sections.zh:
同一 Microsoft 365 页面一处写每日最多连接六次，另一处列每日最多备份四次；它提供 30 天试用，而数据中心页宣传 14 天试用。这些是当前公开资料中未解决的差异，不能默默选择更吸引人的数字。

应要求服务商注明所选服务的调度、保留期、对象范围和试用期。备份频次本身不保证捕获所有来源变化，仍需检查任务及恢复结果。本文不沿用销售文案中“Microsoft 从不备份数据”的笼统说法。

sections.title_en: Confirm location for the selected service
sections.title_zh: 按所选服务确认存储位置
sections.en:
The data-centre page names UK facilities in Slough and Reading and additional Microsoft Azure storage. The Microsoft 365 page also refers to UK and European locations, built-in Azure and bring-your-own-storage options. A UK provider address therefore does not establish the location of every backup copy.

Require the service-specific data location, replication, key responsibility and deletion terms in the order. The public pages describe encryption and certification claims, but this research did not inspect certificates, a contract or operational controls. Those claims are not a compliance determination for a buyer.
sections.zh:
数据中心页列出英国 Slough 和 Reading 设施及额外 Microsoft Azure 存储；Microsoft 365 页面也提到英国及欧洲位置、内置 Azure 和自带存储选项。因此，服务商在英国并不能证明所有副本都存放在英国。

订单应注明所选服务的数据地点、复制、密钥责任和删除条款。公开页面有加密和认证说明，但本次未核查证书、合同或实际控制，不能把厂商说明当作采购方已满足合规要求的判断。

sections.title_en: Request a quote with the charging unit
sections.en:
The current pricing page gives tailored quotes and explicitly allows per-GB, per-user, per-employee or per-pupil billing depending on solution. There is no universal public numeric rate to normalize. Provide workload inventory, protected identities or capacity, retention and restore requirements so that competing quotes cover equivalent scope.

Shortlist BackupVault when supplier-assisted selection and backup operations are useful. A team seeking a self-installed, fixed-price tool should first compare the actual delivery responsibilities. Detailed failure escalation, cancellation, restore charges and software license rights remain contract-specific and were not verified.
sections.zh:
当前定价页提供定制报价，明确可按方案采用每 GB、每用户、每员工或每学生计费。没有可统一折算的公开数字费率。询价应提供工作负载、受保护身份数或容量、保留期和恢复要求，让不同报价范围可比。

希望供应商协助选型和备份运维时，可考虑 BackupVault。需要自装固定价工具的团队，应先比较实际交付责任。具体故障升级、取消、恢复费用和软件许可仍取决于合同，本次未确认。
